description: The headless toggle button core of the SvGrid UI kit in Svelte 5. createToggle is the state machine behind SvToggleButton, pressed on and off with aria-pressed, exposed as buttonProps to spread onto any element. The same core drives the styled component and a custom on and off pill, both bound to one pressed value with a readout.

faq.question: What does buttonProps include?
faq.answer: type button, aria-pressed reflecting the state, a click handler that flips it and keyboard handling for Space and Enter, so any element becomes an accessible toggle.

faq.question: Can the change be vetoed?
faq.answer: Yes. The core calls onChange with the requested state and the bound value is yours to update or not, which is how a controlled toggle stays controlled.

faq.question: Why a core for something this small?
faq.answer: So the toggle in a grid cell, a toolbar and a custom pill share one ARIA and keyboard implementation rather than three.
